name: KCG College of Technology
summary: KCG College of Technology, on OMR at Karapakkam, was established in 1998 by Dr. KCG Verghese and is a unit of the Hindustan Group. It is affiliated to Anna University, autonomous from 2022–23 and accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade; six UG programmes (Aeronautical, Automobile, CSE, ECE, EEE and IT) are NBA-accredited. It offers 15 UG programmes.
